Subject: SIG intake: development integrity packet & CI access playback

Hi Jonas,

We're starting a SIG intake for Redwood ahead of our vendor assessment next month. To complete the questionnaire and the assessor's validation, we need a compact set of artifacts demonstrating your secure development practices. Could you provide the following items within five business days if possible?

- 3 months of code review sampling (redacted usernames OK) with PR IDs and timestamps
- CI/CD pipeline access matrix (who/what service accounts have write/deploy rights)
- List of service accounts and short-lived credential owners + rotation cadence
- Change management ledger for the last 90 days (approvals, rollbacks, emergency patches)
- Evidence of ephemeral key usage (audit trail) — a short playback/audit snippet is fine
- A one-page attestation that the artifacts are complete and representative (PDF)

If any of this needs to be redacted for customer data, let us know what level of redaction you prefer. If helpful, we can schedule a 30 min walkthrough to review the playback.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Assessment Lead
Helios Financial Services

---
Note: we will treat material under NDA; if you need a secure share link or SFTP, tell us what you prefer.

Hi Marta — thanks for the list and the timeline.

We can compile a compact package that covers everything you asked for. Quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:

1) For code review sampling: would 8 representative PRs (mix of feature, bugfix, and hotfix) with diffs and approval traces work? We will redact any customer-specific assets.
2) For ephemeral key playback: do you want a timeline export (CSV) showing access events plus a short recorded session where we replay a single ephemeral key issuance and usage?
3) Attestation: we can provide a signed PDF; will a Redwood Security Manager signature (Irene Choi) suffice?

Proposed timeline: consolidated package in 3 business days (May 7) and a follow-up 30-minute walkthrough the next available day. I attached a short checklist to confirm scope.

Attachments: helios-request-checklist.pdf (checklist of artifacts we will include)

I'll coordinate with our CI owners and operations team to pull the pipeline matrix and rotation logs.

Jonas Weber
